lessons.text: When enforcement lives server-side (e.g. KonFilter/normalizeKonectyFilter rejecting Mongo-shaped input), do not write an AC claiming the SKILL rejects it 'locally': the skill only catches malformed JSON locally and forwards valid-JSON-but-wrong-shape to be surfaced as a server tool-validation error. State where each validation actually happens.
